description:
FAR-Lab: Falsification-Anchored Research Chain — a claim-level verification layer for AI for Science. Deterministic five-value verdict kernel (R0-R9, no LLM arbiter), content-addressed append-only evidence chain with tamper detection, and portable .far-proof verification packages.

JOSS gate 4 (archive DOI) pre-flight file: Zenodo integration declaration. DOI minting requires a Zenodo token (external authorization) — when available, run the GitHub-Zenodo webhook integration (https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/archiving-a-github-repository/referencing-and-citing-content) which auto-mints DOIs for tagged releases.
title: FAR-Lab: Falsification-Anchored Research Chain — a claim-level verification layer for AI for Science
